tex_content.html:
Lemma
[minimizing geodesics realize distance] 1. ch7:2.5↗ def:dc-ch3-3-2 ↗ def:dc-ch7-2-4

A minimizing geodesic segment $\gamma :[0,1]\to M$ satisfies $d(\gamma (0),\gamma (1))=\ell (\gamma )$.
Proof

The geodesic itself is a competitor in the defining infimum, so the distance is at most its length. Conversely, minimality says that its length is at most every piecewise differentiable competitor with the same endpoints; hence it is at most their infimum.

□
